why: Cloud multiplayer lane E: Transfer to This Mac for any Cloud chat (cmux cloud transfer-local). The App part is only CloudTransferLocal (the action binding: argument checks, the machine session, the toast, the moved-chats ledger and the hand-off to CloudBringBack, whose flow it reuses after the folder fetch), its CloudHandlers+Move binding and one hiddenMenuItems union. The rules (owner, new folder, local chat path) live in CmuxNextCloud (CloudTransferRules), the copy and refusal mapping in CmuxNextCloudUI (CloudTransferLocalStrings), and the fetch itself in cmux-tui (link seed fetch). The binding needs App-only types (AppActionContext, AppServices, CloudHandlers, CloudBringBack) that no domain package can reach yet.
